mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE (status = 0 AND due_time < NOW()) OR (status = 2 AND return_time IS NULL)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(borrow_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM borrow_record WHERE borrow_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(borrow_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT(r.id) AS value FROM borrow_record r JOIN book b ON b.id = r.book_id JOIN category c ON c.id = b.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT b.title AS title, COUNT(r.id) AS borrowCount FROM borrow_record r JOIN book b ON b.id = r.book_id GROUP BY b.id, b.title ORDER BY borrowCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
